LESSON: DOMESTIC HYGIENE

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Hygiene Practices
Topic 3.2: Domestic Hygiene

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Domestic Hygiene
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How can we maintain hygiene in the home environment?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. describe the various methods used for cleaning home environment
2. use appropriate methods to clean home environment

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Domestic Hygiene

Teach
• Observe Domestic Hygiene in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Domestic Hygiene (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Domestic Hygiene.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Domestic Hygiene.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Domestic Hygiene.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• describe the various methods used for cleaning home environment
• use appropriate methods to clean home environment

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Domestic Hygiene.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Domestic Hygiene: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can we maintain hygiene in the home environment?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• describe the various methods used for cleaning home environment
• use appropriate methods to clean home environment

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
